Messages.Author: Matt Flint
Messages.Body:
Another question about Baltimore Purge:

Situation: I have 1 minion out, who is not a Lasombra, and this minion
successfully plays BP. Then, during my influence phase, I bring out a
Lasombra. Question: during my next untap phase, when BP burns, do I
get to choose who goes to torpor? I have a Lasombra when the BP burns
and the effect happens, but not when I played the card. In other
words: When do you have to control the Lasombra?

----------------------------------------------------------

Baltimore Purge:

Action. Requires a ready vampire.

If this vampire is Ravnos, this action is at +1 stealth. Put this
card on the acting vampire. During your untap phase, burn this
card, and each other Methuselah chooses a ready vampire he or she
controls who is not older than this vampire. If you control a ready
Lasombra, you choose the vampires instead. This vampire and the
chosen vampires go to torpor.
